clarify.title: Clarify: clear question, no ask
clarify.rule: A clear question is never answered with a question.

clarify.title: Clarify: ambiguous question asks once
clarify.rule: Two doubtful readings get exactly one one-line question with two options.

clarify.title: Clarify: never asks twice
clarify.rule: After the user answers, even vaguely, the system does not ask again.

clarify.title: Clarify: non-interactive run proceeds
clarify.rule: With no one to ask, the run goes on with the default and records the assumption.

clarify.title: Clarify: empty or slow answer
clarify.rule: An empty answer, None, an error or silence takes the default and does not hang.

clarify.title: Clarify: mild ambiguity assumes
clarify.rule: When one reading is the obvious one, assume it, say so and invite a correction.
